GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside midrace & pushed to chase on inside @ 550m. Chasing 3 Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & ran on well in last 200m. Grabbed leader late. # Strong from rear.

Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 9th Inside as much as 24 Lengths off mad Tearaway Leader enjoyed good trail following 1st x 2 Lengths Ridden Along x 600m, clear run home couldn't quicken couldn't finish off (b/ag) # had its chance
Jumped Ok drifetd back 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, battled on one pace # no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 400m, when inclined to lay in, made contact with the hindquarter of another runner. Continued to lay in for the entirety of the home straight and as result proved difficult to fully test.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 3l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, battled on well, no threat late # had chance

Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 7th Inside 8 Lengths then as much as 13 Lengths off Tearaway Leader , 6th into Straight 5th @ 300m, 2nd x 200m now with winner Outside it, Kept Coming Closest on line (syn hoof fill 1st) # Sound eff/finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 5l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3l off, battled on well # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr permitted to ride 1kg over allotted weight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, battled on well but never threatening # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled on pace. Near the 400m was disappointed for a run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 2nd last Two Wide with cover 8 Lengths , asked to go at the 400m, had too much to do but Just Kept Going One Pace (b/1st) # No Run On
Jumped Ok sat handy 2-3l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, battled on strong with limited room # needed room sooner
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr std rounding h/turn he was positioned on-pace trailing the fav, & for this reason he elected not to shift wider & cover additional ground when another rnr improved to his outside near the 500m. Std soon after entering home straight, the fav rnr failed to take him into the race as hoped & his mnt commenced to lay in & was reluctant to shift outwards so it took him some time to secure clear running. Added nearing end of the race, bearing in mind his mnt was inclined to lay in, he had to steady when awkwardly placed & could not test it to the line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 5l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, battled on well # even effort
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th fence 3l 800m 5th fence 4l home turn 5th Straightened Up 3rd took inside run tired final 200m # every chance
